instruction: Candid medium shot of two young girls in a sunny park. On the left, the curly-haired girl in a white cardigan and reddish-brown overalls (R1) stands smiling. On the right, the girl with a pink headband in a blue shirt and pink cardigan (R2) smiles at the camera. They stand side-by-side, holding hands, with R2's hand resting on R1's shoulder. In the far background, a couple of highly blurred figures are visible. Warm, backlit golden hour sunlight creates a soft lens flare.
elements: R2's hand rests on R1's shoulder
R1 is the shoulder-contact receiver while R2 provides the shoulder touch
R1 and R2 stand side-by-side while holding hands
R2 both holds hands with R1 and rests a hand on R1's shoulder
R1 and R2 are in a sunny park with warm backlit golden-hour light
